Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Research

A vault magically warded to imprison and exorcise malevolent spirits and other supernatural forces; haunted portraits, cursed relics, and eerie curios line its shelves. This facility always counts as Haunted.

Esoteric Knowledge. After a Long Rest in your Spirit Vault, you gain one of the following Charms, which lasts for 7 days or until you use it. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice each time) is your spellcasting ability for its spells.

  • Charm of Exorcism: as a Magic action, cast Dispel Evil and Good or Remove Curse without Material components.
  • Charm of Malediction: as a Magic action, cast Hex (level 3 version) or Bestow Curse without Material components.

Research: Ask the Occult. You or the hireling study the relics and question the imprisoned entities for 7 days, then roll 1d6. On a 1, the work is psychically taxing: you take 6d6 Psychic damage, or the hireling dies and the facility can't be used until your next Bastion turn. Otherwise, you or the hireling gain information as if you had successfully cast Contact Other Plane; the hireling shares it with you the next time you speak.

Source: Ravenloft: The Horrors Within.
